limitations_and_boundaries: The study is limited to the Tau-P301S mouse model; findings may not generalize to other tauopathies or human AD.
C1q antibody treatment was only assessed 5 days post-injection; longer-term effects are unknown.
Electrophysiological rescue (LTP) was not observed with a single antibody injection.
Proteomic changes were measured at 9 months of age; earlier time points showed no change in GTPase regulatory proteins.
High inter-animal variability in C1q levels was noted.
The study does not establish whether C1q tagging is a cause or consequence of tau pathology.
